questions.prompt: Ignoring air resistance, the horizontal velocity of a projectile…
questions.explanation: No horizontal force acts, so the horizontal velocity does not change.

questions.prompt: Which launch angle (in degrees) gives the maximum range on level ground?
Which angle (in degrees) gives the same range as a launch at 25°?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles give the same range: $90 - 25 = 65$.

questions.prompt: A ball is kicked at 10 m/s at 30°. Find its time of flight in seconds, to 1 d.p. ($g = 9.8$ m/s²)
A stone is thrown at 14 m/s at 45°. Find its range in metres ($g = 9.8$ m/s²).
At the highest point of its path, a projectile's velocity is zero.
questions.explanation: Only the **vertical** velocity is zero; the horizontal velocity is still $u\cos\theta$.
